name: Low-Carb Turkey and Cauliflower Casserole with Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pound Crimini mushrooms, washed and sliced
4 cups cooked leftover turkey or chicken
Salt and fresh-ground black pepper to taste
why: Squarely mid-band on the source's own numbers: 472 cal, 8.6 g total carbs (5.6 g net), 33 g protein per serving across 8 servings, oven-baked 375F for 40 min. Structurally low-carb (turkey + cauliflower + mushroom + cheese/sour-cream sauce, zero rice/pasta/potato). Uses cooked/diced turkey breast (whole-muscle, board-mapped) rather than ground, and scales cleanly to 14 by weight. Not a catalog duplicate: existing turkey bakes are rice- or broccoli-rice-based; none is a cauliflower-mushroom casserole. Mozzarella is the only ingredient with no dedicated board id (nearest home is generic shredded-cheese) - flagged for the pricer lane.
